objective: Bring a Shimmering Frond to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth

description: The fronds on this plant shimmer in the forest light, giving it a twisting, pulsing aura.
You believe that Denalan would want a specimen of this.
completion: Where did you get this? I haven't seen a plant like this since a sojourn I made to the Swamp of Sorrows... decades ago! It's amazing that a specimen made its way to Teldrassil. And it's grown to such a size!
Thank you, <name>. Forgive my shortness of words, but there is a test I would like to perform on this frond...
